title: My Shoes Walk Me Wherever They Want… Then They Won the Game! 👟⚽
description:
Rudy's new shoes have a mind of their own — every morning they walk him somewhere new! Into the lake, round in circles, and always back to Mrs Doyle's porch to help with her puzzle. Rudy just wants to play in the big championship game… but maybe the shoes knew where he needed to be all along. 👟⚽

A short, kid-friendly story about helping others and how kindness comes back around.
